description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 23.04.2018 to 29.04.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content directly involves the creation and modification of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
